question: Who is the author of the book ‘Hit Refresh’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Satya Nadella**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Satya Nadella is the author of the book 'Hit Refresh'**__.

 __
 
• Nadella announced that profits from the book would go to Microsoft Philanthropy and through it to non-profit organizations.
 
• Hit Refresh is a non-fiction book by Satya Nadella and co-authored by Jill Tracy Nichols and Greg Shaw, with a foreword by Bill Gates published in 2017.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **​Satya Narayana Nadella is the chief executive officer (CEO) of Microsoft.**

 
 
• Before joining Microsoft, Nadella worked at Sun Microsystems, a company that sold computers, software, and information technology services.
 
• In 2019, Nadella was named Financial Times (FT) Person of the Year, "Microsoft was at risk of technological irrelevance but the chief executive has presided over an era of stunning wealth creation".
 
 
 
• **Kazi Nazrul Islam was a Bengali poet,** writer, musician, and national poet of Bangladesh.
 
 
• Popularly known as Nazrul, he produced a large body of poetry and music with themes that included religious devotion and rebellion against oppression.
 
• Nazrul's activism for political and social justice earned him the title of "**Bidrohi Kobi**" (Rebel Poet).
 
• His compositions form the avant-garde music genre of Nazrul Geeti (Music of Nazrul)
